verdict.rationale: cubic offers a manually-invoked 'Ultrareview' mode using its 'most capable review models' for harder tasks, and lets users plug in their own ChatGPT/Claude subscriptions for local reviews, but this is user-selected tiering rather than the tool automatically picking the optimal model per task. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic, task-based model selection without user intervention, and any pricing/cost-optimization framing tied to model choice.
